title: Efrain Bleiberg Explains how to Use Mentalizing to Give a Great Talk
subtitle: A video short
body_html:
I did a training at Menninger Clinic recently. This little clip was among my favorites. It’s a quickie, but I hope you enjoy it!

For those readers who are psychiatrists, I do these trainings regularly at the AACAP annual meeting, and other venues. Feel free to reach out if you'd be interesting an MBT training for your team.
